{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
cross_tab_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print(cross_tab_segment)

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_age to check for imbalance
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel and customer_age (by age groups):")
# Create age groups for better readability
sales_df['age_group'] = pd.cut(sales_df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])
cross_tab_age = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['age_group'])
print(cross_tab_age)

# Check if the groups are balanced
print("\nProportion of returning customers in email:", 
      sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].eq('returning').mean())
print("Proportion of returning customers in paid_search:", 
      sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['customer_segment'].eq('returning').mean())

print("\nAverage age in email group:", sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['customer_age'].mean())
print("Average age in paid_search group:", sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['customer_age'].mean())"}
